title: Asher's first words to J: tune into my heart

tellings.quote: the first thing Asher said to J was like tune into my heart

plain: A documentary filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a film about children who cannot speak but are said to read minds, told podcast host Jesse Michels about two people from her work, Asher and J. She says that the first thing Asher communicated to J was "tune into my heart." She tells it as part of the case that these children can connect with others without words.
